profile.pitch: Hostel mein kapde dhona sabse bada time waste hai. Meri laundry app pe students pickup book karenge, hum 24 ghante mein kapde dhoke, iron karke room tak denge. 99 rupaye ka ek bag, ya 499 ka monthly plan.

answers.vc: Har hostel mein 300+ students, pehle 5 hostels phir poore campus
answers.mkt: Exam week ke time 'kapde hum dho denge, tum padho' wala reel
answers.fin: Ek bag ka kharcha 55 rupaye, price 99, toh 44 ka margin

verdict.compliment: Tumne ek real hostel problem pakdi aur numbers ke saath pitch kiya. Founder energy!
